basis: the registry, the legacy discovery audit, the prediscovery files and the inventory of 2026-10-09 (all digests in the inventory); no new research, no request to any publisher, and no result of the second canary (it has not run)
criterion: READY_FOR_REGISTRATION_REVIEW: a channel is named with search evidence of 2026-09/10 or by a legacy success, the origin is unambiguous, and what is open is a reviewer's judgement, not a missing fact. NEEDS_VERIFICATION: the route or the scope rests on conflicting, old or no evidence. DEFER: not useful in this wave.

first_wave_shape: eight outlets in six countries (ec ×2, es, gt, ni, pe ×2, sv); a canary of eight has 12 item requests per outlet (96 in all, ceiling 100). Two controls (pe_diariocorreo, sv_el_diario_de_hoy), six outlets that never gave the legacy system a usable article. No listing channel and no candidate rule are in it; the policy's disabled-channel list is unchanged by it.
status: RECOMMENDATION — not a registration, not a registry state; the labels are the reviewer's aid (READY_FOR_REGISTRATION_REVIEW, NEEDS_VERIFICATION, DEFER)
